license belongs to VisionD account and device

lifetime, monthly and yearly plans

online license check each use with future offline exception
quantity purchase issues separate keys and renewal extends selected key
customer can view licenses, devices and key securely
program installer download and update delivery
full operator forms for issue, renew, suspend and history
ELON Page is PAGE_SALES and isolated from member ELON
human handoff queue
production Meta webhook signature, dedupe and private participant storage
Meta 24-hour messaging window enforcement on outbound replies
PAGE_SALES AI grounded in verified VisionD catalog, pricing and policies
reply sending with encrypted Page token and retry queue

ad advice: continue, observe, adjust or stop

requirements.reopened_reason: v0.14.67 audit found the Admin entry was never rendered; v0.14.68 adds and verifies the real middleware-rendered entry

requirements.source: V Easy must require VisionD user login and session ownership
one V Easy key binds to exactly one shop
account key shop and Facebook Page must share one owner
one shop has one active bot worker and one worker per conversation
duplicate messages and duplicate chat orders must be blocked
switching accounts must never expose the previous shop chats or orders
Ads Center entry must be visible in the main Admin, not inside Vision 7 Key Center
blocked key issuance must explain the exact missing encryption Secret instead of silently ignoring the click
Ads Center must remain in the main Admin and any stale Vision 7 duplicate must be removed at runtime
Vision 4 combined-product creation must auto-select three previews and expose any blocking error beside the create button
Vision 7 Admin must create a V Easy program and issue an account-owned key with visible errors and no partial records
The Android login URL must exist and verify VisionD ID password and an account-owned V Easy key using the real APIs
B1 must bind one owned key to one shop and return token device and account scope to the APK while logout revokes the server session
ELON must act as VisionD sales team, answer naturally from live published product facts, and never return an incomplete sentence
ELON must know every published catalog category including tattoo, search products by customer intent, and explain exact visible click journeys
Every B1 patch must deliver VisionD web ZIP, matching V Easy source ZIP and a signed APK with a cross-system recheck
ELON Web and ELON V7 must use completely separate D1 databases, bindings, migrations and conversation namespaces; separate tables in one database are forbidden

ELON Web is the VisionD storefront sales team for Guests and logged-in customers; it must answer public catalog questions naturally, keep private account data login-bound, and never share a database with ELON V7
Boss must be able to independently enable or disable ELON Web and ELON V7 from Admin while each control remains in its own physical database
Promotion must keep two, three or more selected categories enabled together; selecting a new category must not disable earlier selections
ELON enable/disable controls in Admin must be polished independent switches rather than stretched raw checkboxes

V Easy product creation must let the owner exit with X or Android Back, close after a successful save, prevent duplicate submissions, and ship with a matching VisionD handoff, source ZIP, and signed APK
V Easy must save and reload products from the real VisionD-owned shop database, enforce account ownership and plan limits, preserve failed form data, and use idempotency to prevent duplicate products

V Easy must use one generic APK for all customers; Admin issues V Easy keys independently from releases, and the customer activates inside Settings with ID Password and Key before one key binds one shop
Boss can enable or disable EasySlip for Vision 5 rights baskets; manual rights slips must be Boss-only, auditable and grant each purchased credit exactly once
Vision 5 must complete a two-account flow from a seller buying rights through Boss approval, permanent course basket binding, course publication, a different customer purchase and learning access
Vision 5 begins with buying rights; one credit creates one course basket draft and users with credits continue through the remaining four steps
When Boss rejects a pending course basket, refund its one credit automatically
